vibe_rationale: Open-access independent arts festival with a deep grassroots base, but broad, diffuse and not a curated single scene.
fit_notes: Adult-leaning independent arts audience across about six weeks and 70 venues, with weak wellness adjacency and no published age data. A partnerships page and email with more than 40 listed partners make the route open, and the open-access model leaves room for a hub or wellbeing partner.
